intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: The live permissioned-data handler serves a signed-commit repo snapshot built in memory via buildSignedCommit and serializeRepo, holding the actor database open while records page out lazily.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Streams proposal-0016 two-root full-recovery CARs from a private bounded-memory spool; the generated handler is retained for typed parameter/context semantics but its Data-returning method is never used by the transport.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: The receiver accepts a repo-host notification when the service JWT iss equals body.repo and aud is the bare authority DID or <authority>#atproto_space_host; the token carries no req body-digest claim and no jti replay record is kept.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: By default accepts only service JWTs whose req claim binds the request body, with iss equal to body.repo and the exact configured authority service identity as aud, and always sends req on notifications it signs. Unbound upstream-shaped tokens are accepted only under --enable-spaces-open-interop, with exp - iat <= 60 s and a durable single-use jti.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: The repo-host receiver accepts service auth whose iss is the space authority and whose aud is the DID of an account it hosts; the token carries no req body-digest claim and no jti replay record is kept. Revocations are retained for 3600 + 2 * 5 s from receipt.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: By default accepts only service JWTs whose req claim binds the request body (space and credential IDs), with iss equal to the space authority and aud a bare DID of an account Swan stores. Unbound upstream-shaped tokens are accepted only under --enable-spaces-open-interop, with exp - iat <= 60 s and a durable single-use jti. Revocations are retained for 3600 + 5 + 300 s from receipt, covering Swan's widest configurable credential expiry skew.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Accepts a registration authorized by the space credential alone; the named service is resolved through its DID document.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: By default also requires an Atproto-Service-Auth header proving ownership of the named service. Credential-only registrations are accepted only under --enable-spaces-open-interop, owned by the named service's DID and capped at 32 per space and 8 per credential subject per hour.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Issues space credentials with a 600 s default lifetime under the 3600 s ceiling.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Swan's own authority issues 300 s credentials; minting and verification enforce the same 3600 s ceiling, finite iat/exp, exp after iat, a required jti, and at most 5 s of future iat.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Stores a managingAppPolicy read or write policy and defers access decisions to the managing app's checkUserAccess.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Rejects a managingAppPolicy read or write policy with 400 UnsupportedPolicy because Swan has no outbound checkUserAccess client; public and member-list policies are unchanged.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Stores a managingAppPolicy read or write policy and defers access decisions to the managing app's checkUserAccess.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Rejects a managingAppPolicy read or write policy with 400 UnsupportedPolicy; already-stored spaces are not rewritten.

compatibilityExceptions.referenceBehavior: POST /:did ends in Express res.sendStatus(200), producing status 200, Content-Type text/plain; charset=utf-8, and the two ASCII bytes OK.
compatibilityExceptions.swanBehavior: Only explicit laboratory policy did-plc-server-0.0.1 accepts that exact no-redirect response at the requested URL; production and all PLC JSON reads retain strict validation.

compatibilityExceptions.referenceBehavior: An old since cursor is filtered with rev > since and returns HTTP 200; the live handler does not emit full_repo_recovery_required for a retention gap.
compatibilityExceptions.swanBehavior: Emits HTTP 409 full_repo_recovery_required when its retained range is exceeded. The recovery CLI remains strict by default and exposes an explicit --allow-full-car-fallback only for qualified reference-host full-CAR testing; fallback artifacts are excluded from retention-gap validation.

retiredCompatibilityExceptions.retiredBecause: Fixed upstream: at bddc99fb the listRepoOps reader qualifies every space selector (space_record_oplog.space) and joins record values on uri AND cid, so value-bearing pages no longer 500. Swan's behavior is now conformant, not an exception.
